prompts.marcelo:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent 4-column x 4-row game sprite atlas, 16 separate FULL-BODY poses of one adult male professor, for Street Vicente Fighter. Use the attached existing sprite atlas ONLY as identity, exact clothing, body proportions and painted arcade-art reference. Make a NEW atlas with the requested fighting poses, keeping the same face, hair, shoes, clothes, outline and colors. View: 3/4 SIDE VIEW facing RIGHT in EVERY pose, same viewing angle as reference. Clean realistic anatomy, complete hands/feet, two arms/two legs. No props, no text, no cell borders, no floor, no lighting effects or action streaks, genuinely transparent background. Equal cells, large EMPTY transparent gutters so no neighboring poses touch or cross cells. Place ONE complete opaque figure per cell with ~12% margin on every edge. Exactly 4 columns and 4 rows. Keep torso and head the SAME pixel scale across all cells; crouching/airborne poses become shorter rather than larger. All standing support feet align at the same baseline within their cell; airborne feet remain fully visible. Fluid dynamic martial-arts poses; preserve professor's normal clothes, no sports costume or gloves. Read order LEFT TO RIGHT then TOP TO BOTTOM.
Subject: Prof. Marcelo, full dark beard, dark swept-back hair, sturdy broad body, olive polo, dark blue jeans, black sneakers.
Fighting style: KRAV MAGA, practical compact stance, protected chin, open lead hand near cheek, rear hand in guard, planted stable stance.
Exact 16 cells:
Row1: 0 neutral compact Krav Maga guard; 1 same guard with subtle weight shift; 2 windup of compact straight palm strike; 3 palm strike fully extended RIGHT at face height, rear hand guarding chin.
Row2: 4 preparation for close knee strike, lead knee beginning to rise; 5 strong knee strike extended RIGHT at opponent's stomach height, sole pointing down, standing support leg planted, both hands guarding; 6 compact low crouch palm windup; 7 crouching palm thrust extended RIGHT at opponent's abdomen height, head protected.
Row3: 8 low-kick chamber, hip low, hands guarding; 9 clear low straight STOP KICK toward RIGHT at ankle/shin height, heel extended, support knee bent, torso upright enough to see face; 10 airborne compact palm windup, both knees bent; 11 airborne palm strike RIGHT with knees tucked, rear hand protecting chin.
Row4: 12 airborne forward-knee chamber; 13 unmistakable forward flying KNEE strike toward RIGHT, one knee extended ahead at stomach height, other leg tucked, hands guard; 14 close grappling setup with hands forward; 15 close elbow strike across toward RIGHT at opponent's chin height, elbow forward, compact bent arm.
Important: knee strikes must show a bent knee as contact point, not an extended kick. Low stop kick distinct and at shin level. Keep Marcelo recognizable as reference.
